title: Transfers Between the Pocketwire Personal Account and Other Pocketwire Products
content:
**Rule.** Transfers between the Pocketwire Personal Account balance and other Pocketwire products are free, post on the same day, and never count toward the P2P send or receive limits or the cash-out limits. An internal debit can be made only while the account status is active, limited or closure pending; a locked account can receive internal credits but cannot move money out, except that a scheduled Pocketwire Advance repayment is still collected. An internal credit that would take the ledger balance above the plan's maximum ledger balance is not made and the money stays in the originating product.

Internal credits are money arriving from another Pocketwire product — a rewards cash redemption, an advance disbursement, a savings vault withdrawal or a business profile payout. Internal debits are money leaving for another Pocketwire product — a savings vault deposit, an advance repayment, a Pay in 4 installment or the recovery of a negative business balance.

**Internal debits by account status** (the rule names the complete set of statuses in which an internal debit can be made)

| Account status | Internal debit |
|---|---|
| Active, limited or closure pending | Can be made |
| Locked | Cannot be made, except that a scheduled Pocketwire Advance repayment is still collected |
| Applied or closed | Cannot be made |

**Internal credits**

| Situation | Result |
|---|---|
| Ledger balance after the credit within the maximum ledger balance | Credited, free, on the same day |
| Credit would take the ledger balance above the maximum ledger balance | Not made; the money stays in the originating product |
